data.notes: January is confirmed as Port of Spain’s pre-Carnival build-up, with soca fetes, boat rides, J’ouvert-style parties and Panorama steelpan events leading into Carnival week.

events.title: Savannah Party - Medium & Large Conventional Band Semi-Finals: National Panorama 2027
events.venueName: Grand & North Stands, Queen’s Park Savannah
events.summary: Pan Trinbago presents the National Panorama 2027 Medium & Large Conventional Band Semi-Finals at Queen’s Park Savannah, one of the core steelpan events of the Carnival build-up.

events.title: Medium Conventional Band FINALS - National Panorama 2027
events.venueName: Grand & North Stands, Queen’s Park Savannah
events.summary: Pan Trinbago’s National Panorama 2027 Medium Conventional Band Finals are confirmed for Queen’s Park Savannah on January 31.

events.title: Soaka Till Sunrise
events.summary: Soaka Till Sunrise is listed as the signature Soaka weekend paint-and-powder fete, running 3:00 AM to 10:00 AM at O2 Park.

events.title: Iron Park - Trinidad Big Soaka Weekend
events.summary: Part of the Soaka Arts & Music Festival weekend, Iron Park is billed around steelband clashes, rhythm sections, DJs and soca at Fatima Grounds.

events.title: Soka in Moka 2027: Enchanted
events.summary: Soka in Moka returns as an all-inclusive Carnival fete at Trinity College, Moka, with food, drinks and non-stop entertainment listed for the evening.

events.title: FETEYARD 2027
events.summary: The Lost Tribe’s fifth Fete Yard edition continues its annual cooler-party concept celebrating Carnival culture through masquerade themes and a larger year-five buildout.

events.title: 1ST JAM 2027
events.summary: SCORCH opens the Carnival-season party calendar with a Port-of-Spain DJ/truck-focused fete billed as “the first movement of the season.”

events.title: Phoenix the Festival 2027
events.venueName: Holy Name Convent, Queen's Park East
events.summary: Phoenix marks its 9th year as a food-inclusive cooler experience in support of Holy Name Convent, with a Soca-artiste lineup and Carnival-party format announced.

events.title: EDAY
events.summary: Erphaan Alves Live lists EDAY as a Port of Spain Carnival-season event running from the evening of January 31 into February 1.

events.title: SOCA NRG International Final: Trinidad 2027
events.venueName: Venue announced closer to the date
events.summary: A three-day international soca dance championship and Caribbean dance-fitness festival weekend bringing qualified dancers from the Caribbean, USA, Canada, UK, Europe, and beyond to Trinidad & Tobago.

events.title: Rum and Music | Cruizin Down D Islands 27
events.summary: Rum and Music’s pre-Carnival DDI cruise advertises two boats, an island stop, local and international DJs, and cooler-fete energy on the water.

events.title: FETE GALA V ALL INCLUSIVE
events.summary: Life Events celebrates five years of Fete Gala with an all-inclusive Carnival-season fete at Queen’s Park Oval.

events.title: RISE - Nasty Jouvert
events.summary: Chill Out Events’ RISE - Nasty Jouvert is confirmed for O2 Park with paint, powder, water and foam; the organizer lists soca, jab, bouyon and dancehall as the soundtrack.

events.title: TRINI SOCA CRUISE
events.summary: VEE TEAM PROMOTIONS, CARNIVAL MAN, 868 ENTERTAINMENT and IZSO PROMOTIONS present a Saturday afternoon soca cruise from Harbour Master in Cocorite.

events.title: French Toast Breakfast Experience: Tribal Oasis
events.summary: House of Siete’s breakfast fete positions itself as an official early-season Carnival breakfast experience, with heritage, food, rhythm, and morning party energy at Queen’s Hall.

events.title: CIAO - Hello Carnival Bikini Breakfast Cooler Cruise
events.summary: Darren Hart & friends present a Carnival breakfast cooler cruise from Harbour Master in Cocorite, with DJs and a 10:00 AM sail time listed by the organizer.

events.title: LAVA ON WATER
events.summary: Lava Brands & Entertainment presents Lava On Water - 2 Wild, an animal-print themed Carnival boat party on Harbour Master.

events.title: Booze&Bacchanal FIRST JAM
events.summary: Carnival Plug’s four-hour Harbour Master cooler cruise brands itself as a legendary Booze&Bacchanal January Jam with nonstop music, drinks, and boat-party energy.
